# Clinical Practice

This folder covers the standardized monitoring, follow-up routines, and guideline adherence for patients with inflammatory bowel disease (IBD) and related conditions in the Danish IBD registry. It documents the use of biomarkers like fecal calprotectin to track disease activity, alongside institutional targets for measurement frequency and systematic annual follow-ups for overlapping conditions such as primary sclerosing cholangitis (PSC).

## Pages

- [[clinical-practice|Clinical Practice]] — Outlines standardized monitoring routines, calprotectin biomarker utilization, and institutional guidelines for managing IBD and PSC patients.
